Boundaries.Name: pubsub-sharded-route
Boundaries.Contract: Share the activation or recovery owner across MOVED and ASK redirects, ASKING, subscription confirmation and cleanup. Acquire error storage only when a failure occurs.

Boundaries.Name: pubsub-sharded-recovery
Boundaries.Contract: Each detached route attempt owns its handled redirects and terminal SSUBSCRIBE rejection, including the completed recovery count. Return the owner after route cleanup; shutdown is excluded.
